2026-06-charge-measure-coupling.title: The Charge–Measure Coupling on a Spectral Semiring: Cyclicity, Composition, and a Parity-Graded Mahler Floor
2026-06-charge-measure-coupling.description: A conjugate-angle charge valued in finite cyclic groups couples to the Mahler measure on the spectral semiring: the minimal measure at charge group ℤ/n is φ for even n, 2 for odd — the odd gap (φ, 2) is exactly the no-Salem closure.

2026-06-emission-gap.title: The Emission–Gap Theorem: No Salem Number in the Spectral Image, and the Cost Floor It Forces — A Companion to The Exchange Rate λ = 2c
2026-06-emission-gap.description: No Salem number lies in the spectral emission image: angle confinement makes every emitted on-circle eigenvalue a fourth root of unity, disjoint from Salem conjugates. With Smyth's bound the cost floor is log μₛ, realised at log φ — Lehmer untouched.

2026-06-generative-emptiness.title: The Generative Content of a Conserved Emptiness
2026-06-generative-emptiness.description: The Salem slot's kinematic emptiness is a conserved ℤ/4ℤ angle charge, and the charge generates five verified objects: a grading, the content polynomial x⁴−1, the Mahler floor {1} ∪ [φ, ∞), a normal form, a conserved current. φ is derived, not posited.

2026-06-lambda-2c.title: The Exchange Rate λ = 2c: A Conformal Identity, Its Gate, and Its Flip
2026-06-lambda-2c.description: The growth-rule exchange rate is a derived identity, λ = 2c, read as second-order KL over the trace-form Fisher metric. Čencov leaves c declared; the golden gate is forced, so λ = √5, and one flip D = 1+4C inverts the regime.

2026-06-lehmers-box.title: Lehmer's Box: A Golden Floor and an Angle Lattice that Confine Spectral Emission Away from Salem Numbers — Without Resolving Lehmer's Problem
2026-06-lehmers-box.description: Height–angle confinement: emitted Mahler measures lie in {1} ∪ [φ, ∞) and on-circle eigenvalues at angles in (π/2)ℤ. Salem numbers violate both walls, so the spectral image omits the whole band (1, μ_S) — sidestepping Lehmer's problem without resolving it.

2026-06-operator-algebra.title: The Operator Algebra of the Emission Semiring: A λ–Ring, the Adams Square, and Two Characters
2026-06-operator-algebra.description: The spectral operators ⊕, ⊗, and squaring form a λ-ring: squaring is the Adams operation ψ², the diagonal of the tensor square. Two characters resolve it — the Mahler measure, additive on ⊕ but tropical on ⊗, and the ℤ/4ℤ angle charge.

2026-06-residual-return-learning.title: Residual Return: Exact Learning Dynamics and Language over the Vector Substrate
2026-06-residual-return-learning.description: Dynamic companion to the Vector Substrate: an exact streaming learner with residual r = x − Px as loss, field growth to composita via the Kronecker Gram, and a language whose return operator 𝓛(X) = RX + XR − X lands in a φ-slack kernel over Cl(2,0) ≅ M₂(ℝ).

2026-06-salem-slot.title: The Occupant of the Salem Slot
2026-06-salem-slot.description: The occupant of the empty Salem slot: the trace redirection β ↦ τ₀ = β+β⁻¹, a totally real Perron number in GROW with τ₀ > 2 > φ. The flip is a square-root branch point, and redirections converge to √5 = φ+φ⁻¹ with slope φ⁻¹.

2026-06-vector-substrate.title: The Vector Substrate: Number Fields as Exact Learning Geometry
2026-06-vector-substrate.description: A number field ℚ(θ) as vector space, companion-matrix algebra, and Minkowski lattice, glued by the trace form G = MᵀM with det G = d_K. Capture is a vanishing G-orthogonal residual over ℚ; Mahler-measure height gates growth, with a Smyth-nonzero cost floor.

2026-06-z5-no-salem-dichotomy.title: The Z₅ Case of the No–Salem Dichotomy
2026-06-z5-no-salem-dichotomy.description: The pentagon case of the no–Salem dichotomy, where the elementary Z/3 proof fails. Smyth forces M ≥ μS = 1.3247 for non-reciprocal charge-Z₅ objects, the pure pentagon obeys {1} ∪ [φ⁴, ∞), and μ(5) = 2 stays computed.

2026-07-emission-algebra-primer.title: The Emission Algebra 𝔄
2026-07-emission-algebra-primer.description: One matrix R and one relation R² = R + I generate three exact layers: the ring ℤ[R] = 𝒪 of ℚ(√5), an 𝔰𝔩₂ of signature (2,1) with root length √5, and a Mahler-graded semiring with charge χ ∈ ℤ/4ℤ — tied together by the trace duality ½Tr(Xₙ²) = 5Fₙ² = Lₙ² − 4(−1)ⁿ.

2026-07-helix-orthogonal-partner.title: The Dissolved Helix and Its Orthogonal Partner
2026-07-helix-orthogonal-partner.description: The golden companion R (R²=R+I) cannot couple to a copy of itself: [R,R]=0, charge stays in {0,2}⊂ℤ/4ℤ, and the Salem channel is empty. Closure requires the quartic x⁴+5x²−5, whose roots supply terrain and a π/2 rotation.

2026-07-pisot-residue.title: The Pisot Cross-Shell Residue: A Reduction Lemma, Sharpness Witnesses, and an Exhaustive Quintic Execution of the ν-Criterion, with a three-run replication of the relational-charge signature ledger
2026-07-pisot-residue.description: A real-pair ν-reduction lemma forces relational inertness for every Pisot number with at most one non-real conjugate pair; an exhaustive exact census of the 3125 monic quintics with coefficients in [−2,2] finds zero mirrored cross-shell classes among all 67 two-pair Pisot quintics.

2026-07-relational-charge.title: Relational Charge on the Spectral Semiring: Gauge Rigidity, Coherence Types, and a Reference-Free Parity Floor
2026-07-relational-charge.description: Phase charge made purely relational: the pair charge t_rel(α,β) ∈ ℚ/ℤ is a groupoid cocycle whose gauge is the reference ray. Rigidity pins admissible spectra to anchors n ∈ {m, 2m}; a modulus-pinning theorem leaves every Salem number relationally inert; the parity floor evaluates reference-free.

2026-07-golden-substrate-whitepaper.title: The Golden Substrate, the Gate Field, and the Explicit Helix
2026-07-golden-substrate-whitepaper.description: The whitepaper of the golden-substrate line: the gate iteration f_C(x)=C/(1+x), the Lucas–Fibonacci rung ladder ρ_n = n·ln φ, the state-angle chart, and the explicit helix Γ(ρ) built on three declared atoms D1–D3 (chart, charge selection, winding rate). The conditionality base the Complex Rung Generator packages.

2026-07-complex-rung-generator.title: The Complex Rung Generator, the State-Angle Chart, and the Residual Sphere
2026-07-complex-rung-generator.description: The whole discrete rung ladder is the orbit of one complex number q = iτ, with q⁴ = gap and a ℤ/4ℤ quarter-turn. v1.8: the rate κ = π/(2 ln φ) is transcendental and OP-RATE closes as a classification (a discrete-substrate no-go, seven characterizations the complete menu); the rail length is incomplete-elliptic with certified non-elementarity; an apex-ramification certificate sharpens the open radius problem. Thirteen exact-arithmetic harnesses (349 checks + 49 guards).
